Add_Sequence_No_To_Entries.sql:
UPDATE Entry INNER JOIN ETL_seeding_upload ON Entry.[Entry_ID] = ETL_seeding_upload.[Entry_ID] SET Entry.Sequence_Number = [ETL_seeding_upload].[Sequence_Number]
WHERE (Entry.Mouse_Name = ETL_seeding_upload.Mouse_Name);

Clear_Unnamed_Entries.sql:
UPDATE Entry INNER JOIN Best_Score_Time ON Entry.Entry_ID = Best_Score_Time.Entry_ID SET Entry.Entry_Used = False
WHERE Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Class = "_";

Copy Of Best_Score_Times_for_current_Eve.sql:
SELECT Best_Score_Time.ID, Best_Score_Time.Entry_ID, Best_Score_Time.Mouse_Name, Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Name, Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Class, Best_Score_Time.Score_Time_mS, Best_Score_Time.Run_Time_mS, Best_Score_Time.Competition_ID, Competition.Competition_Name, Competition.Challenge, Competition.Competition_Class, Competition.Event_ID, Context.Current_Event
FROM Context INNER JOIN (Competition INNER JOIN Best_Score_Time ON Competition.[Competition_ID] = Best_Score_Time.[Competition_ID]) ON Context.Current_Event_ID = Competition.Event_ID;

Entries_for_current_Event.sql:
SELECT Entry.Entry_ID, [Mouse Query].Class, [Mouse Query].Contestant_Name, Entry.Mouse_Name, Entry.Competition_ID, Entry.Entry_Used, Competition.Competition_Name, Competition.Challenge, Competition.Competition_Class, Entry.Registration_Source, Entry.Sequence_Number
FROM (Competition INNER JOIN Entry ON Competition.[Competition_ID] = Entry.[Competition_ID]) INNER JOIN [Mouse Query] ON Entry.Mouse_Name = [Mouse Query].Mouse_Name
WHERE (((Competition.Event_ID)=[Forms]![Context_Form]![Event_ID]))
ORDER BY [Mouse Query].Contestant_Name, Entry.Mouse_Name, Competition.Competition_Class;

Entry Form Query.sql:
SELECT Entry.Entry_ID, Entry.Mouse_Name, Entry.Competition_ID AS Entry_Competition_ID, Competition.Competition_ID AS Competition_Competition_ID, Competition.Event_ID, Competition.Competition_Name, Competition.Challenge AS Competition_Challenge, Competition.Competition_Class AS Competition_Competition_Class, Competition.Competition_Date AS Competition_Competition_Date, Entry.Registration_Source, Contestant.Contestant_Name
FROM Contestant INNER JOIN (Mouse INNER JOIN (Competition INNER JOIN Entry ON Competition.[Competition_ID] = Entry.[Competition_ID]) ON Mouse.Mouse_Name = Entry.Mouse_Name) ON Contestant.Contestant_ID = Mouse.Contestant_ID;

Get_Scores_for_a_Contest.sql:
SELECT Best_Score_Time.Competition_ID, Best_Score_Time.Mouse_Name, Best_Score_Time.Score_Time_mS
FROM Best_Score_Time
WHERE (((Best_Score_Time.Competition_ID)=[Result_Contest_ID]))
ORDER BY Best_Score_Time.Score_Time_mS DESC;

Insert_Manual_Best_Time.sql:
INSERT INTO Best_Score_Time ( Entry_ID, Run_Time_mS, Score_Time_mS, Mouse_Name, Contestant_Name, Contestant_Class )
VALUES (Forms![Manual_Timing_Entry_Run].Entry_ID, Forms![Manual_Timing_Entry_Run].Run_Time_mSecs, Forms![Manual_Timing_Entry_Run].Score_Time_mSecs, "_", "_", "_");

Manual_Set_Entry_Used.sql:
UPDATE Entry SET Entry.Entry_Used = TRUE, Entry.Outcome = "Successful"
WHERE (Entry.Entry_ID = FORMS![Manual_Timing_Entry_Run].[Entry_ID]);

Mouse Query.sql:
SELECT Mouse.Mouse_Name, Contestant.Contestant_Name, Contestant.Class, Contestant.Contestant_Email_Address
FROM Contestant INNER JOIN Mouse ON Contestant.Contestant_ID = Mouse.Contestant_ID;

Populate_Best_Score_Contestants.sql:
UPDATE Best_Score_Time, Contestant INNER JOIN Mouse ON Contestant.Contestant_ID = Mouse.Contestant_ID SET Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Name = [Contestant].[Contestant_Name], Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Class = [Contestant].[Class]
WHERE (((Best_Score_Time.Mouse_Name)=[Mouse].[Mouse_Name]) AND (Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Name = "_"));

Populate_Manual_Best_Score_Mouse_and_Com.sql:
UPDATE Best_Score_Time INNER JOIN Entry ON Best_Score_Time.[Entry_ID] = Entry.[Entry_ID] SET Best_Score_Time.Competition_ID = [Entry].[Competition_ID], Best_Score_Time.Mouse_Name = Entry.[Mouse_Name]
WHERE (Best_Score_Time.Mouse_Name = "_");

Robot_Score_Times_for_current_Event.sql:
SELECT Entry.Mouse_Name, Entry.Outcome, Entry.Competition_ID, Entry.Entry_ID, Best_Score_Time.ID, Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Name, Best_Score_Time.Contestant_Class, Best_Score_Time.Score_Time_mS, Best_Score_Time.Run_Time_mS
FROM Entry LEFT JOIN Best_Score_Time ON Entry.Entry_ID = Best_Score_Time.Entry_ID;

Run_Times_for_all_Events.sql:
SELECT Competition.Challenge, Competition.Competition_Class, Competition.Competition_Name, Entry.Mouse_Name, Contestant.Contestant_Name, Contestant.Class, Entry_Run.Run_Time_mSecs, Entry_Run.Course_Time_mSecs, Entry_Run.Touches, Entry_Run.Score_Time_mSecs, Entry_Run.Date_of_Run, Entry_Run.Time_of_Run
FROM Competition INNER JOIN ((Contestant INNER JOIN Mouse ON Contestant.Contestant_ID = Mouse.Contestant_ID) INNER JOIN (Entry_Run INNER JOIN Entry ON Entry_Run.Entry_ID = Entry.Entry_ID) ON Mouse.Mouse_Name = Entry.Mouse_Name) ON Competition.Competition_ID = Entry.Competition_ID;

Set_Entry_Used_for_ETL_Best_Scores.sql:
UPDATE Entry SET Entry.Entry_Used = TRUE, Entry.Outcome = "Successful"
WHERE (Entry.Entry_ID IN (SELECT  ETL_Best_Score_Time.Entry_ID FROM ETL_Best_Score_Time));

Update_Saved_Context.sql:
UPDATE Context SET Context.Effective_Date = [Forms]![Context_Form]![Event_Date], Context.Current_Event = [Forms]![Context_Form]![Event_Name], Context.Current_Event_ID = [Forms]![Context_Form]![Event_ID], Context.Database_Version = [Forms]![Context_Form]![Database_Version]
WHERE (((Context.ID)=1));

Used_Entries_Contest_Scores_Current_Even.sql:
SELECT Used_Entries_with_contest_for_current_Event.*, Best_Score_Time.Score_Time_mS, Best_Score_Time.Run_Time_mS
FROM Used_Entries_with_contest_for_current_Event LEFT JOIN Best_Score_Time ON Used_Entries_with_contest_for_current_Event.Entry_ID = Best_Score_Time.Entry_ID;
